stem: How has use of the technology described in this excerpt impacted the United States?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: By increasing the number of workers in the agricultural sector

options.label: G
options.text: By increasing the amount of time used to manufacture goods

options.label: H
options.text: By increasing the efficiency of workers and businesses

visual_elements: Evidence for “productivity miracles” arising from the computer and from information technology (IT) in general appears to be all around us . . . The New York Stock Exchange handles electronically a volume of transactions that was inconceivable in the pre-computer age. Businesses nowadays can compute and communicate far faster than they could, say, a decade or two ago. —Alan S. Blinder and Richard E. Quant, “The Computer and the Economy,” The Atlantic, December 1997
